verdict.rationale: Handelsregister/Unternehmensregister is a public company-register search and publication portal, not an AI agent or host application. Consuming tools from plugged-in MCP servers (the MCP client role) is a category error for this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows it ships any agent or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
